reason: The issue is in dpkg-source unpacking 3.0 (quilt) source packages, implemented by Dpkg::Source::Package::V2 and V3::Quilt in libdpkg-perl and the dpkg-source executable in dpkg-dev. Both binary packages and all four entry/implementation paths are absent in the actual stopped-image rootfs. Installed dpkg is the runtime binary package, not the affected Perl source extractor. No claim that dpkg 1.22.22 itself has an upstream security fix.
upstream_fix: Only source extraction Perl modules changed. Trixie source package remains vulnerable/no-dsa; sid 1.23.12 fixed. No sid runtime-package upgrade is needed for an already absent component.
rootfs_archive: Stopped actual image inventory export; no image command or supplier was executed for the absence check.
boundary: Installing dpkg-dev/libdpkg-perl or adding any of the absent source-extractor paths invalidates this assessment; retain raw scanner finding.
